provider_reuse_boundary: MET Norway was already used by Stage304-308. This package reuses the provider but selects a disjoint station network. It can support test isolation, not provider independence.
station_selection_rule: Use the same official Frost eligibility rule as Stage304, remove every Stage304 station ID, partition latitude into 57-61, 61-64, 64-67, and 67-72, sort each band by longitude then station_id, and select three equally spaced positions by round(i*(n-1)/2), i=0..2.
selection_observation_access: Only official source and availableTimeSeries metadata were read. No observation value was requested or inspected.
quality_rule: Retain a value only when the official Frost qualityCode is 0 (controlled and OK). Frost qualityCode 1 can mean corrected or missing and interpolated, so it is not accepted. Quality codes are data-quality metadata, not attack labels. Values with codes 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, or 7 are retained as missing.
missing_rule: Missing values and disallowed quality codes remain missing; no interpolation, sentinel substitution, or imputation is permitted.
coverage_rule: A station is retained only if the primary air_temperature coverage is at least 0.70 in every split year and at least one accepted value is present in each split. The 2025 test split ends at 2025-08-24T23:59:59Z and is not a full-year test period.
multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across pre-registered primary comparisons; station-clustered bootstrap intervals.
selection_boundary: Stations, years, split, features, detector components, candidate rules, thresholds, attack parameters, seeds, baselines, primary endpoint, and statistics are frozen before any observation value is downloaded.
attack_boundary: All attacks are transparent controlled injections, not real attack logs.
forbidden_claims: The disjoint MET Norway network is a new independent provider.
Disjoint stations prove station or provider independence.
Controlled injections are real production attacks.
The new network may overwrite Stage304-308 results.
